name: Somchai Boonchu
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the roaring engines and precision engineering of the Bangkok street racing scene. After completing his vocational training in automotive technology, he honed his skills at a local garage before landing a coveted position at a performance tuning shop specializing in custom fabrication. His dedication to precision and his ability to adapt to rapidly changing situations quickly made him a valuable asset. 

He joined Walkenhorst Motorsport three years ago, initially drawn by their reputation for innovation and relentless pursuit of performance. Somchai's approach to fabrication is rooted in a deep understanding of material science and a commitment to meticulous craftsmanship. He believes that every weld, every joint, and every component plays a crucial role in the overall performance and reliability of the race car. What sets Somchai apart is his ability to troubleshoot complex problems under pressure and his unwavering commitment to delivering results, even when faced with tight deadlines and challenging conditions.

physical.description: A lean man with calloused hands and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of humming quietly while welding.
Insists on using a specific brand of welding gloves he's had for years.
